issue.title: Throw exception if unrecognized parameter in bulk action/metadata line

labels.name: :Distributed/CRUD
labels.description: A catch all label for issues around indexing, updating and getting a doc by id. Not search.

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
It now throws an exception when an action/metadataline of a bulk request contains an unknown parameter or object like:

``` json
{"index": {"_index": "test", "_type": "doc", "_id": 1, "_foo": "bar"}}
```

``` json
{"index": {"_index": "test", "_type": "doc", "_id": 2, "_unkown": ["foo", "bar"]}}
```

Closes #10977

body: btw. this is also in `1.6` so we better check if we wanna keep it there since it seems to break logstash?
#11331 throws an exception if a "metadata" field (like `_id` , `_type` etc)  contains a null value. Let me know if this must be fixed on ES side.

we should see if this is a regression on the logstash-output-elasticsearch plugin /cc @talevy .
